purpose: The RL pipeline for SupplyMind. Core: a Gymnasium wrapper (rl/gym_env.py, 408-dim obs, MultiDiscrete[7,40], action masking) around the in-repo simulated supply-chain environment (server.supply_environment); online trainers (MaskablePPO via sb3-contrib in train_ppo.py, QR-DQN with CVaR in distributional/, constrained PPO with Lagrangian lambda, HER, A2C/RecurrentPPO baselines, Optuna HPO); an "AutoResearch" loop (autoresearch.py) that runs QR-DQN hyperparameter experiments and grades them; offline RL (BC/CQL/IQL/TD3+BC/Decision Transformer in offline/ and decision_transformer/) trained on buffers built from real datasets (DataCo 180K Kaggle orders, NOAA IBTRACS, USGS, FRED, WGI) by real_data_pipeline.py and data/build_unified_buffer(_v2).py; plus auxiliary modules: DT+QRDQN ensemble, specialist router, world-model surrogate + GPU Monte Carlo, TFT commodity forecasting, GNN attention viz, federated-learning demo, Pareto frontier, Ollama-based RAG and explainer, LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen 2.5, SHAP interpretability, ONNX export, numba fast MC engine, and a hand-rolled CUDA action-mask kernel.
verdict: Two-faced subsystem. The core is genuinely real and better than typical hackathon work: training actually ran (100+ checkpoints with varied sizes, autoresearch_results.json shows plausible varied grades 0.24-0.85 and per-experiment 4-6 min timings), the 300MB+ of DataCo/NOAA/USGS/FRED source data physically exists and the buffer builders genuinely parse it, and the trainers (PPO/QR-DQN/offline v2) are competent, complete implementations. But wrapped around that real core is a shell of fabricated "wow features" that directly violate the no-fake mandate: real_world_benchmark.py hardcodes agent scores and converts grader scores into invented "real-world late rates" and "$-savings" via made-up arithmetic; leaderboard.py ALWAYS serves a fabricated table (its CSV dependency doesn't exist anywhere) complete with fake Â±std and a hardcoded "significant at p<0.01" claim; pareto/frontier.py claims to "train 20 policies" but runs the same scripted agent 20 times with different seeds; gnn/attention.py serves attention weights from an UNTRAINED randomly-initialized network to the dashboard; tft.py's trained-model predict path is a stub that never computes a forecast; the dashboard consumes the hardcoded-formula analysis modules (byte-identical to the "legacy fallbacks") while the "Phase J trained models" pkls sit unused at runtime; and the flagship "real" offline buffers label actions via a heuristic whose taxonomy contradicts the environment's own action space ("cancel" doesn't exist; index 1 means alert in the buffer but activate_backup in the env). Add reorg bitrot (WGI xlsx moved to _dump, breaking two scripts; explainer rename breaking dashboard import) and heavy local Ollama/RTX-4080 coupling, and this is a strong engine buried under demo theater.
